name: Notochampsa
sum: Notochampsa is a protosuchian crocodyliform from the Early Jurassic lower Clarens Formation of South Africa, among the youngest of its grade.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fossils from the lower Clarens Formation; PBDB also lists the Elliot Formation and Zimbabwe's Forest Sandstone.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Broom 1904
